header: GET /api/announcements/<id>/file the PDF of an announcement, shown in the browser (inline) GET /api/announcements/<id>/file?download=1 the same, saved as a file GET /api/announcements/<id>/file?info=1 {name, bytes} as JSON (what the viewer asks when it was opened without that information) I keep this open to whoever may read the announcements (they are public on the home page). The address of the file in Vercel Blob never leaves the server: this route fetches it and passes the bytes on. An announcement with no PDF, or a database that has no table for PDFs yet, gets a 404.
